{{Quote|Imperial High Command decided that defender pilots would only be selected from TIE Interceptor pilots who had flown at least twenty combat missions and survived. We're either the best pilots in the Imperial fleet or the luckiest.|Onyx Leader Rexler Brath|<ref name="NEGVV" />}}
'''Onyx Squadron''' was an elite [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. At some point following that conflict's [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] from the squadron participated in the [[Battle of Talus]]. Onyx Squadron also became one of the Empire's first full squadrons of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]], a starfighter model which began production shortly before [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY's]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], which a handful of the squadron's TIE/D Defender element ultimately participated in.

==History==
[[File:OnyxSquadronAce-SWZ.png|thumb|right|270px|Onyx Squadron was one of the Empire's first squadrons of TIE/D Defenders.]]
Onyx Squadron was an elite<ref name="Envelope">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2018/8/27/pushing-the-envelope|text=Pushing the Envelope&mdash;Preview an Imperial List for X-Wing Second Edition}}</ref> [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] within the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] fought between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]].<ref name="CCG" /> The squadron was named after the substance [[Onyx/Legends|onyx]] and, like many Imperial [[Starship/Legends|starship]] squadrons, it was named for something dark in [[Color/Legends|color]] to emulate [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader's]] famous [[Black Squadron (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Black Squadron]].<ref name="SWGTCG">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|cardname=Onyx Four}}</ref>

At some point following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], an element of Onyx Squadron's [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bombers]] participated in the [[Battle of Talus]]. With the Empire discovering a [[Talus base|secret Alliance base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]], a detachment of the squadron's [[TIE series/Legends|TIE/sa]] [[Bomber/Legends|bombers]] escorted Imperial [[Transport/Legends|transports]] to the planet, [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombing]] the planet and allowing the transports to land near the base for an ultimately unsuccessful [[Ground warfare/Legends|ground assault]].<ref name="DS">{{SWGTCG|set=Squadrons Over Corellia|scenario=Dark Side scenario campaign}}</ref>

By [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], prior to the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Onyx Squadron also became one of the first full squadrons of [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE/D Defenders]].<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|414|Onyx Squadron}}</ref> Only a handful of the squadron participated in the battle itself,<ref name="CCG" /> although they were too few to swing the battle in the Empire's favor,<ref name="SotG">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> and the battle ended in an Imperial defeat by the Alliance.<ref name="Jedi">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

==Organization==
[[File:Onyx_Squadron_Pilot_TIE_Aggressor_XWM.png|thumb|left|200px|A member of Onyx Squadron piloting a TIE Aggressor]]
During the Galactic Civil War, Onyx Squadron was composed of [[TIE/ag "Aggressor" Starfighter/Legends|TIE/AG Aggressor starfighters]] and<ref name="Onyx Squadron Pilot (TIE Aggressor)">{{FFGXW|set=TIE Defender Expansion Pack|cardname=Onyx Squadron Pilot}}</ref> TIE/sa bombers.<ref name="DS" /> By 4 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="NEC" /> the squadron also contained TIE/D Defenders, a series of starfighters whose production began shortly before the Battle of Endor.<ref name="NEGVV" />

==Members==
[[File:Rexler_Brath_mini_game.jpg|thumb|right|270px|Rexler Brath was the leader of Onyx Squadron.]]
[[Onyx Four]] was among Onyx Squadron's TIE/sa bombers<ref name="SWGTCG" /> which took part in the Battle of Talus.<ref name="DS" /> By 4 ABY,<ref name="NEC" /> the squadron's [[TIE pilot]]s included [[Rexler Brath/Legends|Rexler Brath]],<ref name="NEGVV" /> [[Captain/Legends|Captain]]<ref name="Death Star II personnel">{{SW|url=news/death-star-ii-personnel-and-imperial-human-resources|text=Death Star II Personnel: An Imperial Human Resources Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Yorr/Legends|Yorr]],<ref name="CCG Yorr">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Onyx 2}}</ref> and [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jendon/Legends|Jendon]].<ref name="CCG2">{{CCG|set=Death Star II Limited|cardname=Colonel Jendon}}</ref> Brath, himself a TIE/D Defender [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]],<ref name="Envelope" /> led the squadron during the Battle of Endor.<ref name="CSWE" /> Yorr flew the TIE/D Defender [[Onyx 2]] which was part of a limited production run of its class, with its production model having a more powerful [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] added based on testing of the Defender's prototype.<ref name="CCG Yorr" /> Jendon, a senior test pilot ordered to shake down the first TIE/D Defenders assigned to Imperial [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] operations,<ref name="CCG2" /> flew the TIE/D Defender [[Onyx 1]], which was designed to emulate Alliance starfighter advantages.<ref name="CCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Onyx Squadron was created for [[2000]]'s ''[[Death Star II Limited]]'' expansion set of [[Decipher]]'s [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]], with the card game introducing individual squadron TIE/D Defenders Onyx 1<ref name="CCG" /> and Onyx 2.<ref name="CCG Yorr" /> The squadron's name was established by [[2003]]'s ''[[The New Essential Guide to Vehicles and Vessels]]''.<ref name="NEGVV" /> In [[2008]], Onyx Squadron was also included in the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] campaign for ''[[Squadrons Over Corellia]]'', an expansion set for the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies Trading Card Game]]''.<ref name="DS" />
